note: TWENTY FILES TOUCH THE MONEY FLOW AND SEVEN OF THEM NEEDED A LINK; the judgement this ticket exists for is WHICH surfaces and WHICH of three pages, not how to render one. THE DISTINCTION THAT DECIDED IT IS ADMIN vs MEMBER-AND-PUBLIC. An admin screen explains how the church OPERATES; a member or public screen is seen by the congregation, and a member did not ask about anybody's reconciliation workflow. So the roster is ADMIN ONLY, and the member-facing candidates were rejected on that rule rather than one at a time: Profile, PartnerWithUsTab, DonationHistory, and the public PublicGiving / PublicCampaign / PublicPledge / CampaignWidget / PublicEventRegistration. DonationHistory WAS WEIGHED AS THE ONE EXCEPTION AND REJECTED WITH A REASON: the member asking 'where is my gift?' is indeed who the email-match caveat is about, but that caveat lives on `recording-a-gift`, whose stated audience is 'whoever does the weekly entry' - it is the STEPS for entering a gift. All three pages are written for the church's side (how the church collects, what the church's routes update, what the church types), so there is no page here that answers a member's question, and a link to one of them would send a member to read staff procedure. The member's real answer is their church, which is not a docs link. THREE OF THE TICKET'S OWN CANDIDATES WERE REJECTED ON MEASUREMENT RATHER THAN TASTE. (1) AdminDashboard.tsx is NOT a figures screen - it is the shell that imports every admin screen and routes between them, so its money references are nav labels and route ids; the dashboard's giving FIGURES live in dashboard/GivingTab.tsx, which is what carries the link instead. It is also pinned in ten places, and THE-111 already measured that cost and split the same file out as disproportionate. (2) settings/PaymentSection.tsx is mounted INSIDE both AdminDonations and AdminFundraising, so linking it would put a SECOND link on two screens that already carry one. (3) donations/GivingLinks.tsx is not an admin surface at all - it renders on PartnerWithUsTab and on the four public giving pages, so a link there is a link on five member-and-public screens. AdminSettings was rejected because THE-246 made its payments row a POINTER carrying an 'Open Donations' button, and a docs link competes with the better in-app answer; its subject, and PaymentSection's and GivingLinks', is payment links, which is a FOURTH docs page this ticket does not ship. PlanUpgradeSection is billing, not giving. ONE SHARED COMPONENT, NOT SEVEN ANCHORS - THE-340 found eleven inlined Resend sends that had drifted, and the twentieth of anything is what this repo keeps paying for. `admin/GivingDocsLink.tsx` holds the treatment once and the page is chosen from a CLOSED UNION, so a surface cannot point at a typo, a missing page or a fourth page - the type refuses it at compile time - and the LABEL is derived from the page beside its href, so two screens cannot link one page under two names. Both height floors are obeyed without minting a number: `min-h-11` is 44px below sm and CONTROL_DENSITY.control is IMPORTED for Rule 4's 38px above, measured in a real Chromium with transitions suppressed because #490 read a 44px floor at 7.7469px mid-transition. It is an <a> with target=_blank and rel=noopener, matching the Documentation row THE-358 put in the account menu. ADMINACCOUNTING WAS CHOSEN AND THEN DROPPED ON THIS TICKET'S OWN STOP CONDITION, and that is reported rather than worked around: its only pin is `UNCHANGED` in manual-payment-link-disclosures, a Record<string,string> asserted with toBe - a single value with no accepted set, no register and no append path, so an edited file can only be admitted by SUBSTITUTING a pinned digest. main went red for everyone the week a PR did that. The file is byte-identical to main and the follow-up is named: convert that entry to an accepted SET keeping the existing digest, exactly as THE-350 did to THE-342's adminCrmDigest. NOTHING THE PREVIOUS TICKETS OWN WAS DISTURBED: the THE-362 accounting copy including its no-email condition is untouched because the file is untouched; AdminFundraising gains a LINK AND NOT A SENTENCE, deliberately, because a link gift genuinely does not move campaigns.raised and 'recorded gifts count' would be a new false claim there; the statements link sits ABOVE and OUTSIDE the pinned disclaimer block after a measurement showed that placing it below put it INSIDE that block; THE-355's event disclaimer, the Contacts/Roles switcher and the single partnership button with no status line are all unchanged. No new token, no new dependency and no colour literal; every URL was verified to EXIST at the docs source rather than assumed, because the network policy in this environment refuses docs.theharvest.site.

entries.why: THE-368 adds ONE ELEMENT to this file: a GivingDocsLink pointing at `recording-a-gift`, inside the `actForm.type === 'donation'` branch of the Add Activity dialog, directly beneath the two notices THE-350 put there. THIS IS THE ONLY SURFACE IN THE APP THAT GETS THAT PAGE, and the reason is that this is the only place a gift is ENTERED: the amount field is here and the save writes the donation receipt. The page is 'the exact steps, and the email-match caveat', which is the long form of precisely the two things the notices above it state in short - what a recorded gift reaches, and that a contact with no email address can never be shown it - so the link lets an admin go deeper without either notice growing a sentence. IT IS INSIDE THE DONATION BRANCH, not the dialog body: on a note, a call, an email or a meeting no gift is being recorded and the link would answer a question nobody asked. NO READ, NO WRITE, NO GATE AND NO STRING MOVED. `addActivity`'s ordering - the ledger POST first, so a refusal writes nothing - is byte-identical, as are `amount: null`, `invoiceId`, `invoiceAmountCents`, the activityError alert and both THE-350 notices; THE-362's two delete refusals, the single dialog definition and the contactActivities sweep are untouched; the payment-links disclaimer THE-338 made collapsible keeps its text and its keepMounted fold, and the Contacts/Roles switcher is still ONE subTabBar rendered on both sub-views. The file's seven hexes are unmoved and the link adds no eighth: it spells `text-muted` and `text-body`, which are palette tokens. It adds the file's first tappable target since THE-350 asserted it added none, and that target clears 44px below sm and sits at Rule 4's 38px above, measured rather than asserted.

THE-368 adds ONE ELEMENT to this file: a GivingDocsLink pointing at `the-money-flow`, immediately after the manual-payment disclaimer Alert in the event form and under the SAME condition that draws it - manual confirmation mode with at least one payment link saved. CONFIRMING AN EVENT PAYMENT IS ONE OF THE TWO ROUTES IN that the money-flow page describes; recording a gift in the CRM is the other. An admin who has just been told that Harvest cannot check anything and that THEY will confirm each payment by hand has exactly one next question - what that confirmation actually updates - and that is the page's subject. AFTER THE ALERT AND NEVER INSIDE IT: the disclaimer's text is pinned and this adds a sibling to it, changing not one character; an event with no manual payment draws no link at all. NO READ, NO WRITE AND NO PATH MOVED - this ticket adds no Firestore operation of any kind, so nothing here could need a rule or an index. THE-345's price gating and its three-state notice, THE-355's 'Registered' badge and re-labelled stat, the Check In gate that still reads only registration status, THE-326's removal of the rota view, THE-308's lazy month-view mount and THE-346's List/Month tab-bar classes are all untouched, and the registration URL shape is byte-identical. The link mints no pixel height: it carries `min-h-11` below sm and the imported CONTROL_DENSITY.control above it, and hardcodes no colour.

THE-368 adds ONE ELEMENT to this file: a GivingDocsLink pointing at `the-money-flow`, directly beneath the campaigns AdminPageHeader. A CAMPAIGN'S PROGRESS BAR IS A FIGURE, and on this screen it is the figure most likely to look wrong to the person reading it: a gift that arrived through one of the church's own payment links genuinely does NOT move `campaigns.raised`, so an admin watching the bar sit still after a gift came in is holding exactly the question the money-flow page answers. IT IS A LINK AND NOT A SENTENCE, AND THAT IS THE WHOLE CARE TAKEN HERE. THE-362 swept the other giving screens and LEFT THIS ONE DELIBERATELY UNCHANGED, because the claim it would have had to make - 'recorded gifts count' - is FALSE of campaigns.raised, and flattening that into the sweep would have been a new false claim about money on the one screen that was right. So this ticket adds no copy to this screen at all: a destination and nothing else. The component cannot restate a claim even by accident - its label is the docs page's own title, derived from the page rather than passed in by the caller. NO READ, NO WRITE, NO GATE AND NO COPY MOVED: every existing string on the screen, the PaymentSection mount it shares with AdminDonations, the campaign list, the create flow and the raised/goal arithmetic are byte-identical. No colour is hardcoded and no height number is minted.

THE-368 raises ONE NUMBER in this file and adds the paragraph that says why: RULES_PINNERS_NOW goes 76 to 77, because this ticket's guard suite is a new pinner that reaches the accepted rules-digest set through the shared module. THE COUNT IS RAISED, NEVER LOOSENED - the floor exists to catch a suite that quietly STOPS pinning, and that still fails; no pinner was retired, no accepted value was widened and no digest was replaced. WHY THIS TICKET PINS firestore.rules AT ALL: it edits seven admin components and adds one, and a reviewer is entitled to know that a ticket touching the giving surfaces did not touch the file that auto-deploys to production on merge. It did not, and could not usefully - the whole change renders an anchor, so there is no Firestore read, write or query anywhere in it for a rule to express, which is also why THE-368 records NO firestore.rules digest of its own in this directory. AN EARLIER DRAFT OF THIS TICKET'S SUITE SPELLED THE RULES DIGEST AS A LITERAL, which is exactly the copy-per-suite defect this register was built to end, and THE-325's own sweep caught it before it could land; the suite now reaches the value through rulesDigestFailure() and spells no hash. Nothing else in this file moved: every ownership assertion, the validate refusals, the population pins and the unrecorded-digest checks are byte-identical.
